metadata.name: MnDOT Aeronautics State Funding Prioritization Model
metadata.agency: Minnesota Department of Transportation, Office of Aeronautics
metadata.source_citation: MnDOT Aeronautics State Funding Prioritization Model Guide. Encoded from source PDF at Priority_Model/Example Prioritization Models/MnDOT State Prioritization Model Guide.pdf. Five criteria are tracked as MnSASP performance metrics in MnDOT's interactive dashboards.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded MnDOT model as additive_100pt with 60-pt System Plan Alignment bucket and 40-pt MnDOT Priorities bucket
decisions_log.rationale: Source document explicitly states 'SEVEN CRITERIA ON A 100-POINT SCALE / 60 Points - System Plan Alignment / 40 Points - MnDOT Priorities'.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.rationale: MnDOT uses -5/-10 scores for non-compliance (e.g., obstructions identified with no programmed fix scores -10).

criteria.label: Master Plan / ALP
criteria.description: Evaluates whether airport has updated Master Plan/ALP per MnSASP targets and whether project is in the plan.

subcategories.label: Updated ALP/Master Plan on file and project request is in plan
Airport has programmed ALP/Master Plan update or is in process
Inadequate ALP/Master Plan with no updates programmed

criteria.label: Airspace Obstructions (Part 77)
criteria.description: Evaluates whether airport's Part 77 surfaces are clear of obstructions per MnDOT licensing OR whether project clears them.

subcategories.label: Submitted project will clear obstructions in Part 77 surfaces
Airport has no obstructions in Part 77 surfaces
Airport has at least one submitted obstruction clearing project
Obstructions identified in Part 77 surfaces with no programmed fix

criteria.label: Clear Zones
criteria.description: Evaluates ownership/CZAP status for MnDOT-defined clear zones.

subcategories.label: Project will acquire MnDOT clear zone land
100% clear zone ownership or approved CZAP on file
Land acquisition project submitted OR actively coordinating CZAP
Partial/no clear zone ownership without CZAP and no programmed fix

criteria.label: Work Type (Preservation vs. Expansion)
criteria.description: MnDOT prioritizes preservation of existing assets over expansion. Pavement-condition-deficiency-driven scoring.

subcategories.label: Airport has identified pavement deficiency per MnSASP metric AND project remediates it
Airport has adequate pavement; project addresses other pavement issues
Adequate pavement; project maintains other airport assets (e.g., lighting)
Project constructs new facilities or expands existing infrastructure
Pavement deficiency identified with no programmed fix

criteria.label: Zoning
criteria.description: Evaluates whether airport has proper zoning established with MnDOT Aeronautics.

subcategories.label: Adequate zoning established and on file with MnDOT
Establishing or updating zoning to comply with MnDOT
No adequate zoning and no programmed mitigation project

criteria.label: Airport Component
criteria.description: Where on the airport the project is directed; primary runway weighted highest.

subcategories.label: Primary Runway
Taxiway Serving Primary Runway
Secondary Runway
Apron
Taxiway Serving Secondary Runway
Other Airfield Location
Taxilane
Terminal Building or Fuel Facilities
Hangar
Other Buildings
Landside
Unknown

criteria.label: Licensing Compliance
criteria.description: Evaluates compliance with Minnesota Rules 8800.1600 Public Airport Licensing or remediation thereof.

subcategories.label: Airport compliant with all state licensing standards
Partial compliance with corrective actions underway
Non-compliance with no corrective actions

governance.approval_process: MnDOT Aeronautics applies the model to state-only funding requests for MnDOT-defined capital expenditures. Performance for five of the seven criteria is tracked publicly in MnSASP Hub dashboards. Tied to MnDOT's Project Selection Policy and Minnesota GO recommendations.

disclaimer: This model encoding is derived from MnDOT's State Funding Prioritization Model Guide. The prioritization model only considers state-only funding requests for MnDOT-defined capital expenditures.
